Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 8
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly stated there was “No new result to analyze” right after WebSurfer had surfaced an authoritative royal.uk result confirming Buckingham Palace as the monarch’s official residence and administrative headquarters. This misinterpretation stalled progress and led to repetitive, circular instructions instead of synthesizing the new evidence and moving on to verify the Waterloo Vase’s location via the Royal Collection. The looping behavior prevented reaching the correct, concise answer (the British monarch’s residence and administrative headquarters at Buckingham Palace).
